newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Chilean president to visit Singapore before APEC.
newsitem.headline: Chilean president to visit Singapore before APEC.

text.p: Chilean President Eduardo Frei will visit Singapore from November 21 to 23, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs said in a statement on Wednesday.
It will be the first official visit to Singapore by a Chilean head of state, the ministry said.
Frei will call on Singapore President Ong Teng Cheong and Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong separately and lead a meeting with a Singapore delegation headed by Goh.
During the visit, Singapore and Chile will sign agreements that include port training, trade development and business and private sector cooperation.
Frei, who will also deliver the keynote address at a Trade Development Board luncheon, will be accompanied by Minister of Economy Alvaro Garcia, senior government officials, and business delegates.
Frei is scheduled to fly from Singapore to Manila to attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit on Monday.
According to the Singapore Trade Development Board, trade with Chile totalled Singapore $431 million (US$308 million) in the first 10 months of 1996, up from S$336 million in the same period of 1995.
